submission.policy: Each property is computed two ways: BUILD PATH (Microsoft Building Footprints polygon × Vision LLM-derived pitch) and SOLAR cross-check (Google Solar API). When the two agree within 15%, the build path is submitted. When they diverge by more than 15%, Solar acts as a documented tiebreaker. Solar is a configurable provider (SOLAR_MODE=off|fusion|primary); pipeline runs without Solar when off.

vision_llm_pitch.reasoning: The roof faces show moderate visible area from above with moderate foreshortening, and the shadow cast by the ridge is consistent with a standard 6:12 pitch; the complex hip-and-gable roof structure with visible but not overly compressed faces suggests a typical moderate slope.

The roof shows moderate face area visible from above with a complex hip-and-gable design, moderate shadow lengths from the ridge lines, and visible roof face foreshortening consistent with a standard 6:12 pitch typical of this style of residential home.

cross_check.rationale: build path diverged from Solar by >15%; Solar used as tiebreaker (validated against public records on representative cases — see README)
